summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CDN optimization streaming APIs and video player UI. All 17 backend tests passed. All frontend UI components (Data Saver toggle, Quality selector with bandwidth info, Auto quality indicator, Settings panel) are working correctly.

POST /api/streaming/quality - Saves user preference (480p, 360p)
POST /api/streaming/quality - Blocks 720p for free users (403 VIP subscription required)
POST /api/streaming/quality - Blocks 1080p for free users (403 VIP subscription required)
POST /api/streaming/quality - Rejects invalid quality values (400 error)
POST /api/streaming/quality - Requires authentication (401/403)

GET /api/streaming/bandwidth-estimate - Returns personalized estimates with data_by_quality

GET /api/streaming/preload-strategy/{episode_id} - bandwidth_saving_mode=true for anonymous
POST /api/streaming/data-saver - Enables data saver (quality=360p)

POST /api/streaming/data-saver - Requires authentication

GET /api/streaming/hls/{episode_id} - Returns 404 for invalid episode
